_note: Copy to weather.json and fill in your own entity ids, then shoot with `node dev/shoot/shoot.mjs phone-weather`. Real patches are gitignored — they name entities, and this repo is public. A patch is applied in flight on the way into setConfig; Home Assistant is never written to. A missing patch file is logged and the config renders unpatched.
_note_2: Use ONE of the two shapes above at the top level of the real file — the nesting here is only so both are documented in one example. $appendSections [ ... ] is also available.
